name: Zammad
summary: HTTP 8080 for the bundled nginx, with its WebSockets.
notes: The target is the zammad-nginx container of the Docker deployment, which already splits the application and its WebSocket server; a package install has the same nginx on 80. Set NGINX_SERVER_SCHEME=https there, or the session cookie is not marked secure and signing in fails with a CSRF error. The health check Zammad offers needs a token, so this one only asks for the front page.
